notes.title: Politics The Game - DEVLOG #2
notes.notes:
[p]As the classic saying goes: [i]the rumors of our death have been greatly exaggerated[/i]. Politics: The Game is alive, breathing, and — heavens forbid — even starting to work.[/p][p][/p][p]We're currently working on a chapter where we set out in search of right-wing voters… in a certain radio station in Toruń.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035912/433c5ca3a3e80d187037eb42c5a2704e60a4da04.gif"][/img][/p][p]Someone here’s got something to confess! Holy water only burns true sinners![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035912/6712155f4fc14002fef2fd551c4cb0a615a4c13b.gif"][/img][/p][p]Luckily, some burn with the holy fire of outrage already — no ignition required![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035912/decdf7d79b4c862d7c9cab652a5092436df28a30.jpg"][/img]You can't just record on any old equipment! Father Director spares no expense.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035912/9e8f0a5a4df50c80bcc79f1e0247edb91bce0311.gif"][/img][/p][p]And finally, the most important part — a live radio show! After all, you’ve got to convince the listeners to support the station with a modest donation — of their life savings![/p][p][/p][p]That's all for today. Thank you for your attention, and we hope we've satisfied at least a bit of your curiosity — maybe even your spiritual hunger. Tune in next time — we’ll have an important announcement for you… ;)[/p]

notes.title: Free Demo available now!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]The day has come![/b] – we’ve just released the [b]free demo![/b][/h3]  
You can all download it now and step into the shoes of a rookie politician!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035912/c330e3d68a9c3a390482ca41f8552ca70427298f.png[/img]

[b]What can you expect in the demo version? A proper introduction to the political rat race, including:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] A story-driven intro that immerses you in the absurd world of Polish politics  
[*] Early missions like founding your own party and winning over your first voters  
[*] Core gameplay mechanics – exploration, combat, minigames, environmental interactions – with a tutorial  
[*] And loads of humor!  
[/list]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035912/c8c474a9796e49b4f5dc9e7ef8304737ba688d13.gif[/img]

Jump into the Polish political scene with a bang and lead your politician from a green backbencher straight to the prime minister’s seat. Make choices that will test your morals and creativity. From innocent little lies in local interviews to ritual cow-milking under the TV spotlight – there are many ways to climb the ladder, but is it always worth the risk? The answer: “it depends.” One thing's for sure – you should definitely grab the free demo and find out for yourself!

[h3]Play the demo now![/h3]

Add the game to your wishlist and follow it on Steam so you don’t miss the full release! Now get to work – that electoral sausage won’t grill itself!

notes.title: Politics The Game - DEVLOG #1
notes.notes:
We hereby declare that (contrary to the deceitful suggestions of the opposition) work on Politics the Game is ongoing!

Below, we present hard evidence from the early stages of development.
First up – combat! Brand new, incredible, truly epic!
Or at least… it will be.
Because right now, it doesn’t work…
And we all know whose fault that is!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035912/ef9eb629374fffd928d87d3b140fe3c8e2d52e8a.png[/img]

But like any true Polish Party, we have chosen to take care of our national treasure – the POLISH COUNTRYSIDE and the OPPRESSED POLISH FARMER!

Unlike the soft, well-manicured hands of our political rivals, our hands have known hard labor! See for yourselves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035912/58ffed79b1b1bc9ca847e09eb191c5072a21c337.gif[/img]

As you can see, we have arrived in Gnojniki Górne – a small village near Warsaw. Above, you witness a rare recording of a politician engaging in real work. This time, instead of milking the citizens – he's milking a cow.

If that’s not enough to win over the people, our fiery speech surely will. It has already brought us many new supporters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035912/c8c474a9796e49b4f5dc9e7ef8304737ba688d13.gif[/img]

As you can see, the Polish countryside holds many secrets, where past and present intertwine, and from the depths of the barn… the ghosts of our ancestors emerge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035912/204bfbf682f20716f2a47ddc8abfdef2dc311ae3.gif[/img]

Now, behold the heart of our operations – our parliamentary office.
Cozy? No.
Has it ever witnessed the murder of a homeless man? Probably…
But you know what? That’s a good thing! It serves as a constant reminder of our mission!

You’d have to lack all dignity to squander public funds on golden chandeliers and mojito machines – like certain opposition parties do…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035912/63f35fa0a3f094a836f0a8cb1274e13a769ab430.png[/img]

The world is ours to conquer! Well, not the whole world – but Warsaw!
A city full of districts to reach, voters to persuade, and secrets to uncover…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035912/72c8dffd10f954ff7632b4bb37de23843c9930e3.png[/img]

Honorable Chamber, work continues, bills are being written, amendments are being introduced. We will report further progress soon!
